The wide plaza that sits in the northeast is used for a variety of activities by [[Vabbi]]ans, including but not limited to trading, festivals, plays, and socializing. The [[Font of Lyss]] can be found at the center of the plaza. ==Getting there== Characters will pass through here out of [[Vehtendi Valley]] as part of the [[primary quest]] [[Rally The Princes]], on their way to meet with [[Priestess Haila]] in the center of the plaza. ==Exits== *[[Garden of Seborhin]] (north, talk to [[Seborhin Protector Zuor]] before [[Grand Court of Sebelkeh]] [must bring
